CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus.
   B. Use Jesus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Jesus has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
